# Sitrep

> Santiago de Chile situation board — live earthquakes, weather, air quality, Metro status, and official alerts on one tactical board

- Live: https://sitrep.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
